notes.title: Outpost L5 v1.9 in beta today
notes.content:
Faster Bullet Speed and lots of small improvements.
Added additional controls for the Oculus Rift
Minor Bug Fixes

notes.title: New Release V1.09
notes.content:
New Features:
New Death Animations for Player and Red Alien
Faster Player Bullets

Bug Fixes:
Fixed Mother Ship getting stuck at times
Fixed player death on respawn (finally)

notes.title: Outpost L5 scheduled for launch!
notes.content:
We are looking to launch on the 28 or sooner.

Beta testers, please test latest build.

Beta 7-26-17v2:
Audio volume reduced
Faster Player Bullets
Improved Oculus RIFT UI 

Known bugs: 
UFO/Mothership gets stuck , if it is within your field of fire and you can kill it. 
Ocasional Respawn shield failure causing ship death
Killing mothership near play edge can cause the powerup to be unreachable

Other bugs???
